readiness: Share with the stated single-seed development and historical-baseline caveats.
training: Two fresh jointly trainable BT4-initialized models, seed 0, 1000 matched batch-1024 updates each, full current/future history, actual search root Q/D targets, WSD stable phase, FP32 storage and BF16 compute. Not frozen-backbone arm training and not a full epoch.

formulations.native: Native BT4 current WDL head and auxiliary JEPA future WDL predictions.
formulations.jepa_residual: Current native BT4 WDL logits, W/L perspective-swapped at odd horizons, plus zero-output-initialized JEPA WDL residual at H0 through H8. Gradients also enter the native baseline.

play.mode: Searchless one-pass DFM for trained models, native policy for raw BT4
play.finding: BT4 is clearly strongest in this pool. Both pilots are weaker than Hero1. No resolved strength difference between the value formulations.

loss_findings: All four models were measured on identical 8192 boards and played-move targets, preserving each checkpoint's history contract. Historical Hero1/raw BT4 metrics exactly reproduce EV-007.
Both pilots have lower one-pass DFM CE than Hero1, but lower top-1 accuracy and weaker play. Played-move CE is not a monotonic strength metric here.
The pilots' native-policy CE is worse than raw BT4 and original Hero1. Lower composite training/validation objectives did not preserve the pretrained policy.
Residual final value CE, expected-Q MSE and Brier score are slightly better than direct-value results, but no playing-strength improvement was demonstrated.
Eight-pass CE and top-1 are worse than one-pass for both pilots. Eight-pass play was not tested in this tournament.
limitations: Single seed and development openings, no held-out or absolute Elo claim.
New-versus-new is matched. Original Hero1 is at 554 updates / 567296 examples and differs in corpus, history, precision and schedule; this is not a clean value-versus-no-value ablation.
Intermediate composite validation uses 2048 positions; terminal validation uses 8192. Do not present initialization-to-terminal composite means as exactly the same pool.
Value targets are soft search root Q/D, not observed game outcomes. No common raw-BT4/Hero1 value-loss comparison was run.
Marginal 95% bounded-opening-pair intervals, not simultaneous inference across all matchups.
followup_not_launched: Do not promote these checkpoints on strength. A matched 1000-update no-value control and policy-preservation diagnosis would be needed before blaming value supervision or extending either pilot.
retention: Final model and exact recovery states at updates 554 and 1000 retained for both pilots; no assets deleted.
verification: All 1536 games legally replayed with original opening/repetition histories; WDL, color pairs, intervals, legal coverage and all 10 per-position policy aggregations independently reconciled. 149 targeted tests passed.
